bio: The steep approach to this beautiful inn situated above the village is well worth the effort – both for the fantastic view of the valley and for the delicious food. Classic cuisine and traditional regional fare are served here, in the form of aromatic dishes packed with flavour. The menu features local char as well as Tristan rock lobster, Tauern lamb two ways, and a classic Wiener schnitzel. Diners can also look forward to a good selection of wines. An experienced team provide friendly service; cosy atmosphere....
